description: Unit test class for KafkaClientActor in the Eclipse Ditto project, testing connection handling, message publishing, and metrics retrieval via mocked Kafka interactions.

classes.name: KafkaClientActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for KafkaClientActor, testing connection, messaging, and metrics functionalities with mocked components.

classes.name: MockKafkaPublisherActor
classes.description: Mock actor simulating Kafka publisher, forwards messages and reports actor status.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by initializing actor system and starting mock server.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down actor system and stops the mock server after tests complete.

methods.name: startMockServer
methods.description: Creates and starts a mock server socket for testing Kafka connectivity.

methods.name: stopMockServer
methods.description: Closes the mock server socket to release network resources.

methods.name: initializeConnection
methods.description: Creates a new Connection object for use in tests with mocked server details.

methods.name: testConnect
methods.description: Tests opening and closing Kafka connection and ensures proper actor responses.

methods.name: testPublishToTopic
methods.description: Verifies message publishing to Kafka topic and proper message formatting.

methods.name: testTestConnection
methods.description: Tests connection initialization logic and success response.

methods.name: testTestConnectionFails
methods.description: Simulates and verifies failed connection attempt handling.

methods.name: testRetrieveConnectionMetrics
methods.description: Tests retrieval of connection metrics via actor messaging.

methods.name: getKafkaClientActorProps
methods.description: Constructs actor Props for KafkaClientActor with mock publisher actor factory.
